before.name: c. 3000 BC: Stonehenge begins to be built. In its first version, it consists of a circular ditch and bank, with 56 wooden posts

after.name: c. 3000 BC: Stonehenge has an early circular earthwork and 56 pits; the pits’ original use is uncertain

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The earlier entry said 56 wooden posts; the cited research describes pits whose original contents are uncertain. The detailed Wikipedia article estimates the first phase around 3100 BCE; English Heritage says around 3000 BCE. The existing 3000 BCE one-year gameplay slot and coordinates are retained, not newly established as exact. Radius is a gameplay setting. Other Stonehenge rows require independent review.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: approximate; 3000 BCE is the existing gameplay reference year, not a proven exact date
